messages.content: Write a plain-language supplement of at most 75 words. Use one sentence per delivered annex, in its given order. For the US, state why it vetoed and preserve every stated destination for return. For Russia, preserve the reason for supporting the draft and its reservation. For Indonesia, name the representative and distinguish the national remarks from the vote notification in the Council President capacity. If both the US and Russian annexes are delivered, add one sentence explicitly comparing their shared concern and opposite votes. If either annex is absent, make no statement about that delegation's rationale or a shared concern. Keep each explanation attributable to its owner. Use the public record only for procedural context. Avoid restating the public record, attaching legal status to the failed draft, or describing whether evidence was supplied. Output only the requested sentences.

{"fixed_public_record": "On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. It created no new Council authority or requirements.", "annexes_delivered": {"us-explanation": "In its national explanation, the United States called return to countries of origin or nationality the essential first step. It vetoed S/2020/852 because the draft lacked a reference to repatriation."}}
